name: pvr_sector_breadth_complete_round_interaction_v1
hypothesis: A high PVR may indicate continuation when the sector broadly participates but local exhaustion when participation is narrow. Learn only one PVR-by-contemporaneous-sector-breadth interaction, with both main effects. No sign constraints or feature/state/parameter search.
domain: Original PVR actually filled first MOBILE rounds only (1814). Do not combine CORE/E31, extrapolate scores to rejected candidates, or claim account results.

features.B: Existing industry_breadth20 at signal close: fraction of original fixed sector roster with valid same-segment20-observation mean and close above it. Same-time feature, no future return or annual state. Original roster is static future-known and NOT PIT-certified.
features.scaling: Training-only mean/std for P and B, clipped at +/-5 as in existing protocol. Interaction = zP*zB, centered/scaled on the same training rows; absent scale => common UNKNOWN.
features.economic_slope: At a fixed breadth value the PVR effect may change sign; only one interaction, not a tree.

clock.training: Monthly first common trading session cut. signal_t>=cut-504 and entry_t<=cut-120. Labels W/L only from actual complete0-to0 net PnL closed by entry_t+119. If any mature training U remains, stop binary fit rather than silently drop it. All controls share train/test masks.
clock.evaluation: 2023-2025 signal years with common120 potential observations primary. 2026 partial only with censoring and no final-win extrapolation. 2022 always UNKNOWN.
clock.purge: Every training label endpoint entry_t+119 is strictly before monthly cut, so no training outcome interval overlaps prediction month.

support.each_natural_breadth_side: B>=0.5 and B<0.5 each >=20 wins,20 losses,30 unique signal dates. No separate fits by side. Count check only, not sufficient evidence of stable effect.
support.unknown: Any support failure makes all four controls UNKNOWN that month. Any missing P or B makes that event UNKNOWN. No min constituent gate or imputation.

estimation.loss: Event-weighted Bernoulli NLL sum +0.5*(4*betaP^2+4*betaB^2+16*theta^2), intercept unpenalized; absent terms omitted. Original event sampling preserved; dependence controlled in evaluation, not treated as independent evidence.
estimation.solver: NumPy damped Newton; gradient max<1e-6, max100 steps; numerical failure => UNKNOWN all arms, no penalty change.

metrics: Brier/logloss, calibration with fixed probability bins
AUC and within-same-day AUC with all support counts
causal training quintiles with every group reported
payoff ratio, mean winner/loss, net return upper/lower tails
fixed same-day top-half ranking diagnostic within old selected samples only, including rawPVR baseline and right-tail retention
evaluation.dependence: 20-common-day blocks and stock clusters; paired mean-loss influence with conservative max(block,stock,two-way) normal95 CI; AUC delete-block/delete-stock jackknife; annual intervals exploratory.
evaluation.ranking: Top ceil(n/2) among the identical known original selected rows per day, no decision threshold. Constant ties resolved originalPVR then sid. Not a new policy or estimates for unbought names.
evaluation.right_tail: Report actual return>=20% retained and existing complete60 big60 retained relative to rawPVR/additive; original path quantities, not counterfactual gains.

falsification: No promotion unless paired main proper-score improvement survives dependence, annual same-day sorting is not reversed, and original right-tail retention is not worse. Regardless of result no account run and no35percent claim from selected bins.
reused_pair_scope: 151 existing cash-boundary pairs may be audited for input/rank reach only; no new model prediction on rejected stocks and no imputed complete-round labels.
limitations: Support thresholds fixed after viewing support counts but before new model results; historical data has already been repeatedly studied, not untouched OOS.
Static future roster/industry, original execution proxy, selected-only sample and final source cutoff remain limitations.
